title: FailurePattern
description: One known error signature and how to resolve it. Served by the search_failure_patterns tool (matches free-form error text against signature_pattern) and the cmp://runbook/{pattern_id} resource (direct lookup by id); assemble_log consults both mid-investigation.

signature_pattern.description: The error-message template this entry matches -- identifiers wrapped in {placeholder} (or a literal '...') mark the variable parts search_failure_patterns treats as wildcards.

cause.description: The hypothesized root cause this entry is built on, stated as its own field so that if the fix fails, the next step can specifically check whether THIS cause was actually true, rather than re-diagnosing from nothing.

instruction.description: How to resolve this issue -- may include conditional branches, tool calls, or escalation guidance. The LLM uses this to decide what to do next.

source_reference.description: Traceability back to where this entry came from, e.g. a CSV row, an incident ticket, or an engineer's note.
